svg.title: 50 launchpads on eight chains
svg.desc: Every launchpad a DEFADE scan names, by chain: the chain and the launchpad are read from the address.
svg.text: EVERY LAUNCHPAD, READ OFF ITS OWN CONTRACTS
The scan names where a token came from, and on a bonding curve reads its stage and price from the curve itself.
Pangea launches one token on five chains at once; the scan names it on all five.
A token outside a launchpad is scanned the same way, from its pools.
